story_type: basket hoist from a fishing boat nearly 100 miles offshore
hook: 98 miles out at sea, he had to get off this boat.
narration: Ninety-eight miles east of Cape Cod, a forty-six-year-old fisherman needed to get off this boat.
The Osprey was a fishing boat out of New Bedford, Massachusetts.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Air Station Cape Cod came in over the deck and sent their rescue basket down.
In a hover, the pilot cannot see the deck below, so the flight mechanic at the door calls out every move.
Then the basket came up off the deck and swung out over open water.
At the door, the crew pulled him inside.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew flew him to Boston Logan International Airport, where an ambulance met them.

location_card.place: 98 miles east of Cape Cod, Mass.

title: 98 miles out, lifted off the Osprey
description:
In May 2012, a Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod Jayhawk crew hoisted a 46-year-old man from the New Bedford fishing boat Osprey, 98 miles east of Cape Cod, and flew him to an ambulance at Boston Logan airport.
